hero_desc1: ServerKherson is a web-based cloud shell application that allows users to securely access and manage remote servers.
hero_desc2: We use Google OAuth authentication to protect user accounts and ensure secure access to private server resources. Only basic profile information is requested for identification. The platform offers a variety of applications including cloud file management, media galleries, interactive maps, server monitoring, recipe management, expense tracking, health tracking, and network utilities — all accessible through a single account.
promo_body: If you do not have an account yet and want to use the full potential of these applications, create one: registration is completely free.
gallery_empty: No screenshots are available for this application yet.

apps.portal: Landing, auth, and registration — the hub for all apps on this server
apps.cloud: Cloud file manager with editors (3MF, PDF, LaTeX...)

app_details.portal: The main ServerKherson web hub: landing page, sign-in, and registration — your gateway before opening individual applications hosted on this server.
app_details.cloud: Comprehensive cloud storage manager with built-in editors for 3MF, PDF, LaTeX, markdown, photo manipulation, and audio transcription. Supports real-time collaboration and versioning.
app_details.films: Personal movie database with comments, watchlist, and categories. Track what you've watched and share reviews.
app_details.map: Interactive map viewer supporting KML, GPS exchange formats. Save favorites, measure routes, and view terrain.
app_details.performance: Real-time server monitor: CPU load, memory usage, disk I/O, Apache module status. Historical graphs.
app_details.recipes: Create, share, and collect custom recipes. Organize by ingredients, tags, and meal types.
app_details.spends: Expense tracker similar to spreadsheet with charts, monthly statistics, and store-based categorization.
app_details.steps: Activity tracker for steps, distance, calories. Set daily goals and view progress over time.
app_details.tft_generator: Generate TFT screen code from canvas drawings. Convert sketches into display-ready code.
